record_type_quote: We replicated two of BJF’s experimental designs to re-examine how shared pain affects bonding and cooperative behavior.

targets.authors: Bastian, B., Jetten, J. and Ferris, L.J.
targets.title: Pain as social glue: Shared pain increases cooperation
targets.evidence_quote: Experiment 1 re-examined the robustness of the main BJF findings, testing whether shared pain in Chinese subjects enhanced interpersonal bonding and cooperative behavior. In experiment 2, we added unshared conditions.
targets.outcome_quote: We conducted two experiments that reproduced BJF’s findings. More importantly, we further found that pain does promote cooperation, but only when it is shared. When it is not shared, pain does not promote cooperation.
targets.outcome_reasoning: The discussion provides an overall confirmation covering both experiments. The unshared conditions extend the original and are not framed as a failed replication of an original unshared condition.

reasoning: Two new-sample experiments re-test Bastian, Jetten and Ferris, explicitly distinguishing that target from the separate Bastian et al. review. Publisher full text includes title, all six authors, both experiments, discussion and references.
